collection.description: A villager plans a harmless prank to lighten the mood, and decides how elaborate to make it.

intro.name: The beginning
intro.text: (Prankster) decides that the village has become much too serious. (prankster.He/She) prepares a harmless trick for (Target), using baskets, shells, woven mats, painted gourds, or other ordinary island materials.

a1.text: (Target) jumps, then laughs so hard that the whole village joins in.

a3.text: (Target) anticipated everything and replaces the surprise with a carved sign reading, "TRY AGAIN."

a4.text: A mysteriously moving basket convinces several witnesses that an ancestral spirit is visiting.

b1.text: Clever screens and woven mats make (Target) appear to vanish. The researchers spend an embarrassing afternoon investigating the trick.

text_only.reason: narrative: 'Vanishing' is part of the story, not a change the event makes

b2.text: A hollow bamboo tube produces eerie noises until (Prankster) is caught giggling behind the hut.

b3.text: The prank reveals an unusual echo or air current.

b4.text: The illusion is too convincing. Villagers flee, then demand an apology and help restoring the interrupted work.

c1.text: Several pranksters maintain straight faces until one bursts out laughing and ruins the surprise.

c2.text: A child announces the entire plan to the target.

text_only.reason: rule 9: a sequel is a later event; The Prank War is drawn on its own

c4.text: The prank accidentally hurts someone's feelings. The pranksters apologize and make amends; friendship improves.

a2__fx.text: An elder receives the prank by mistake and gives (Prankster) a long lecture. (Target) finds this hilarious.

a2__text.text: An elder receives the prank by mistake and gives (Prankster) a long lecture. (Target) finds this hilarious.
